page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre; page number top right; a woodcut ornament in the middle of the page; signature line "Ii" and catchword "Fabu-" at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Excusatio à Providentiâ divinâ non habet semper locum.

p.i: Aul. 4.10. v.12. adolescens amator sic excusat scortationem:
Deos credo voluisse, nam ni vellent, non fieret, scio.
At ego Deos credo voluisse, ut apud te me in nervom enicem.

main_text.p: Qui homo culpam admisit in sese, nullus est tàm parvi pretij, quin pudeat, quin purget sese.
Excusatio vitiorum fit multis modis, per vinum, imprudentiam, adolescentiam, seu aetatem.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament in the middle of the page is a decorative fleuron, not text. Some faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored. The first line of the page reads as a heading; the marks between words are as printed.
